composition: Object policy AND field policy AND every nested policy. Disabled dominates. No field or object may be published without a passing runtime visibility test.

contract.predicate: Only copied protocol metadata or already authorized projected values; never read native memory here.

request.predicate: Caller-supplied intent only; exact typed validation, authorization and generation recheck before use.

session.predicate: Only the explicitly authorized local perspective. Omit game/perspective/revision/turn before a game is loaded and after revocation; publish committed turn only, not intermediate calculation.

systems-map.predicate: Only systems whose native map position is drawn for this player. Coordinates are native star coordinates, before zoom/pan. ID assigned after this predicate; no slot-derived numbering.

system-name.predicate: Non-black-hole name only: Player_Is_Omniscient(viewer), or valid native dominant visible owner plus Contact_With_One_Colony, or Player_Has_Visited. Copy bounded CP850 and reproduce rendered outpost lowercase and unvisited foreign Lore parentheses; otherwise unknown. Temporary contact/Lore-only grants expire through existing whole-view revocation on mutation or observed authority loss. Get_Star_Name is evidence, NOT a pure query helper: it changes font/zoom state and may allocate a bitmap.

system-visited.predicate: Only the bound player's visited bit, never the complete bitmask. Does not grant planet/owner/special disclosure.

system-name-visited.predicate: Initial runtime subset: bound human viewer has visited and star is not a black hole. Copy bounded CP850 name, apply native ASCII outpost lowercase on the copy, then decode UTF-8. Contact/lore-only unvisited names remain explicitly unaudited; no UI/font/resource builder is called.

nebulas-map.predicate: Native map draws every existing nebula without a viewer gate. Publish unscaled map x/y and uint8(type) modulo 12 rendered variant with perspective-scoped opaque IDs. Never raw type, hidden gameplay star membership or art/cache pointers.

system-owner.predicate: Native Star_Owner dominant visible owner: self preferred, otherwise largest contact-filtered colony count with native tie order; omniscience removes contact filtering. This is not exclusive ownership. Resolve only a same-capture known-player handle; unknown if unavailable. Do not read foreign economy or trust cached star.owner. Mixed-owner rendering and outposts do not grant live colony details.

system-exploration.predicate: Planet roster and extended-range verdict require visited-or-native-omniscient non-black-hole system. Wormhole destination/known-empty requires visited or native omniscience, not destination-name knowledge. Use existing read-only Star_In_Extended_Range_Of_Player at coherent capture, including native odd-range rounding, blocks, visited-wormhole shortcut and alliances; no new movement math, ship-specific movement/ETA calculator or UI builder. Resolve only real same-capture systems/planets. Unknown differs from explored empty lists/known-empty wormholes. Temporary contact/Lore grants use existing whole-view revocation on mutation or observed loss, not a new cache/lease.

planets-explored.predicate: Filter system exploration before planet copying, validation, counts, IDs and events. Include all occupied orbits in visited-or-native-omniscient non-black-hole systems, plus independently authorized own full-colony locations. Public one-based physical orbit is distinct from compressed occupied-slot Roman name ordinal. Copy native asteroid/gas-giant/planet kind; ordinary planets expose size 0..4, gravity 0..2, base planet climate 0..9, minerals 0..4, special 1..10 (0 and Orion 11 known-empty), cached half-food units, native mineral productivity and read-only gravity penalty/hostile-environment suitability. Nonplanet ecology/name/suitability is known-empty. Copy bounded CP850 native no-Prime name without mutating shared temp buffers. No foreign colony climate/population/buildings/production, system reward or stale UI summary/hover/movement values. Native stores shared current planet data, not per-player historical ecology; do not invent last-known values. Opaque disclosed-location IDs are world/perspective scoped; retained captures immutable.

planet-suitability.predicate: Maximum population uses the native read-only Planet_Max_Population_For_Player only for an authorized ordinary uncolonized planet or own full colony, after validating own inputs. Foreign/outpost-dependent maximum population is unaudited and never calculated from alien live population/races/buildings. Preserve native 0..42 result, traits/mod tables and storage cap; no economic forecast or new calculator.

exploration-own-colony-links.predicate: Resolve reciprocal planet/own-full-colony references only through the same fresh capture's validated system/orbit graph and actual queryable planet/colony families. Never mint phantom planet handles, link a foreign colony or use historical handle tables as authority. Unknown when no authorized same-capture counterpart; not inferred known-empty foreign intelligence. Handles and immutable pages obey world/perspective revocation and ordinary indistinguishable unavailable errors.

disabled-system-owner.predicate: Pending per-field review of Star_Owner, mixed owners, visited/contact/lore and outpost semantics. Raw star.owner forbidden.

players-known.predicate: Bound active human viewer only. Include self and foreign empires listed by the native race screen: current contact, eliminated (even without contact), or native Player_Is_Omniscient including cached Galactic Lore. Prior contact alone is not current contact. Gate before reading bounded CP850 name/color; copy name, color, eliminated and living-foreign contact separately, not historical eliminated-contact flags, portraits/traits/government/research or hidden economy. Own name is also displayed by the self race report. Sort the authorized projection before assigning unpredictable perspective/game-scoped handles; no native slots, hidden counts or gaps in numbering are exposed. A temporarily absent empire cannot be looked up using an old handle.

player-own-economy.predicate: Only the bound local player's already calculated HUD values: bc, surplus_bc, surplus_food, n_freighters, surplus_freighters, command_points and native int16 command_points-minus-used result. Preserve signed deficits/known zero. Foreign treasury/HUD are explicitly unaudited and never read, even under native omniscience. Research display branches, forecasts, totals/maintenance and calculators are not enabled by this policy.

player-contact-war.predicate: Only a currently contacted living foreign empire in this same capture's authorized roster: copy whether the viewer's directed treaty entry is >=4, the native UI/diplomacy war classification. Read only the viewer's treaty array, not foreign attitude/treaty/AI state. Self, eliminated and uncontacted empires (including omniscience/Lore-only rows) return unknown, never an inferred false. Discard unavailable values before ordering, equality, revisions or notifications. Known false means a current living contact is not classified at war by the native treaty display; it is not a claim of safety, future intentions, or bilateral intelligence. No raw treaty codes, labels, payments or hidden exact attitudes are exposed.

player-contact-research-treaty.predicate: Only currently contacted living foreign empires in the same authorized roster. Copy whether the viewer's own directed research_treaty[target] is nonzero, the native race-screen gate for displaying the research-agreement summary. This reports presence only, not agreement level/goal, RP/BC amounts, opponent research, treaty duration, AI attitude or future renewal. Self, eliminated and uncontacted rows including omniscience/Lore-only roster entries are unknown, not false. Never read a foreign reciprocal flag or derive presence from war/contact alone. Sanitize unavailable values before sorting, equality, revisions or notifications; retain stable player handles and one coherent map/ship/roster capture. No diplomacy/spy/research calculator or UI builder is invoked.

player-contact-trade-treaty.predicate: Only currently contacted living foreign empires in the same authorized roster. Copy whether the viewer's own directed trade_treaty[target] is nonzero, the native race-screen gate for displaying the trade-agreement summary. Presence only: no current agreement level/goal, BC amount, duration, reciprocal foreign flag, AI attitude or renewal forecast. Self, eliminated and uncontacted rows including omniscience/Lore-only entries return unknown, never inferred false. Sanitize unavailable claims before ordering, equality, revisions and notifications. Keep stable player handles and one immutable coherent map/ship/roster capture; never splice newer treaties into an older ship capture. No diplomacy/economy/spy calculation or UI builder is invoked.

disabled-planet.predicate: Pending read-only equivalent of native explored-planet policy; do not invoke a mutable list builder. Orbit/name/type separately gated.

colonies-own.predicate: This list is explicitly the bound active human viewer's own full-colony roster, following native Colonies/transport lists: owner equals viewer and outpost_flag is zero. Foreign intelligence and outposts are not included. Filter before reading links/population, sorting, counts, handles, revisions or notifications. At the same map/roster capture, copy a validated system reference and one-based orbital position and cached n_pops resident population (0..42 whole displayed population units, not thousandths, growth or inbound settlers). Validate planet/star/colony backlinks and uniqueness. Resolve system/owner through the same capture; discard private bindings before retention. No UI list builder, Sum_Colonists, forecast or economic calculator is called. Opaque read-only observation handles are replaced on authorized collection changes, not durable colony identities/action capabilities. Known-empty refers to this own-full-colony scope, not to foreign intelligence.

colony-own-troops.predicate: Only the bound active human viewer's own full colonies after owner/outpost authorization and parent-link validation. Copy existing military[0] infantry and military[1] armor counts, 0..32767 native int16 units, including known zero. Print_Scanned_Military displays these exact counts; Do_Colony_Info_Military_Stuff_For draws the units or the exact compressed count. Armor covers the native tank/battloid presentation, not a newly inferred unit design. Do not add population militia, inbound troops, troop strength, growth/roundoff, future production, weapon/armor technology or foreign/outpost intelligence. No troop popup, UI builder, invasion limit or combat calculator is invoked. Same immutable map/ship/roster/colony capture as population; hidden-only counts do not affect handles, revisions or notifications.

disabled-colony.predicate: Production/queues, buy costs/eligibility and remaining colony details stay unaudited. Same-capture queryable planet links have their separate exploration-own-colony-links policy. Do not invoke mutable builders/calculators for queries. Foreign intelligence is a separate policy.

ships-refreshed.predicate: Capture surviving associations only synchronously post-Build_Ship_Icons for the bound active human viewer, outside world mutation/resolution. Follow fresh icon heads that are surviving stack heads and their linked nodes; never enumerate unlinked allocations or rebuild for a query. Copy map x/y and own-versus-foreign classification; names and known-player owner references require their additional field policies. Sort the authorized projection before assigning opaque read-only observation handles; no native slots or durable ship identity are published. One coherent map/ship capture, explicitly dated last-native-ship-refresh. A fresh last-native-fleet-box capture may reuse still-valid surviving associations under the reviewed ship-map-eta authority, without later node traversal or enriching any older retained capture. Handle sets are replaced when the projected ship collection changes; no action may use them.

ship-own-name.predicate: Ship.name retains its canonical in-game ship-name semantics, never a substituted hull-class/UI label; no displayName field is introduced. Current implementation: only the bound viewer's own ship, a bounded NUL-terminated copy of d.name decoded from CP850 to UTF-8 at the same authorized post-refresh capture. Foreign name bytes are never read; native disclosure of a hull label does not authorize their canonical name, which remains explicitly unaudited rather than a scan-knowledge claim.

ship-owner-known.predicate: Only a surviving freshly displayed ship. Resolve own ownership or a known empire's banner-color identity to an opaque player handle in the same coherent capture's authorized roster. Foreign mapping requires a unique color in that public roster; ambiguous colors, unlisted owners and special/NPC owners remain explicitly unaudited. Never use an old handle table or newer roster to authorize the link. Discard private owner bindings before retaining snapshots; compare only the resolved public ID. Ownership does not authorize enemy names/designs, routes, ETA, orders, cargo or economy.

ship-map-route.predicate: Ambient subset at fresh surviving-icon capture: own route, or non-own moving head with enemy_moves presentation or the existing Enemy_Ship_Heading_Toward_Our_Colony predicate. Preserve the native outpost predicate's ignored player argument and non-own, not necessarily hostile, semantics. Validated ambient stack members share only the displayed head's location/owner/position route. Additional contextual subset: only a surviving non-own head with canonical movement encoding (status-2 upper-offset departure, including ordinary departure, or status-1 ordinary moving-offset transit) whose actual selected/open-box destination line was drawn during current initialized main-owner presentation, in the same native frame before its actual non-preview cached fleet-box ETA producer. Reject mixed status/location encodings. Ordinary map-icon ETA printing follows the line observation but is not the fleet-box producer or an independent context grant. An open box or copied destination alone never authorizes it. Validate exact surviving head and complete current membership under ship-map-eta; grant only this head's route and ETA under one revocable capture lease. Resolve only real same-capture systems to opaque handles and discard private bindings. Line presentation grants map-position knowledge, not an unvisited system name; producer star -1 is withheld name knowledge, not known-empty. Revoke contextual destination and ETA together through pages, subscriptions, bridge work/publications, delivery receipts and service output; preserve independent ambient reads. Stationary own location is known-empty; remaining selection data is context-required and special destinations get no fabricated handles. Detection, contact, ownership and omniscience alone never authorize routes. No query invokes UI builders, renderers or movement calculators.

ship-map-eta.predicate: Preserve cached uint8 turns_left including zero/255; never calculate ETA. Ambient ordinary-route ETA belongs only to its surviving displayed head. Fleet-box subset: actual non-preview cached producer for a surviving own/non-own upper-offset head with independently current ambient destination, or the canonical departing/ordinary-transit contextual head audited in ship-map-route. Require initialized active main owner/presentation, exact complete current open-box membership and no stale selected references; empty selection is valid. Foreign ambient enemy_moves or native incoming-colony/outpost gates are rechecked at production; they are not relaxed for ordinary contextual disclosure. Contextual destination instead requires actual same-frame line presentation followed by the fleet-box producer, not arbitrary cached or map-icon ETA. Capture associations only at refresh; validate box members' private owner/location/status/generation and public position, reject retirement/slot/node reuse without later node traversal. Never read foreign canonical names or use private checks for public identity/sorting. Copy borrowed values into a fresh immutable coherent six-topic capture including session, stamped last-native-fleet-box; never enrich retained captures. Resolve only real same-capture destinations; producer star -1 withholds its name, not map knowledge and not known-empty. Revoke both contextual fields through retained pages, subscriptions, bridge work/publications, delivery receipts and every service-output fragment on authority loss, owner/box replacement, child interruption, rebuild, world/perspective changes and resolution. Started revoked messages close rather than finish; preserve independently authorized ambient offscreen reads. Equal fresh presentation after rebuild retains public IDs/revisions but never revives expired pages. Other upper-offset/non-head ETA remains context-required, stationary own ships known-empty, special destinations get no fabricated handles. Grants no extra names, unaudited routes, orders, cargo, designs or hostility classification.

disabled-ship.predicate: Unmapped/special owner identities and enemy canonical names/scan details require independent native authorization and initialized-context visibility tests. A hull-class label is not the canonical ship name. Surviving detection or known ownership does not authorize raw location, cargo, orders or enemy design data. No scanner-policy extraction is needed for the post-refresh projection.

disabled-fleet.predicate: Group only already authorized ships; stable IDs must not be rebuilt stack indices. Destination/ETA separately filtered.

disabled-design.predicate: Own templates or actual active scan-authorized details; calculators must be audited for mutation before sharing.

disabled-leader.predicate: Only owned or actually offered/discovered leaders; no enumeration of generated/hidden hero slots.

disabled-report.predicate: Only copied player-authorized messages and authorized entity links. Never call a report display/consume operation as query.

disabled-options.predicate: Only options actually offered to the local player by the owning context; no hidden eligibility/AI reaction oracle.

disabled-movement.predicate: Specified own live ships and known destinations; share audited read-only verdict logic, never mutate scratch/UI or expose hidden defenders.

disabled-research.predicate: Own progress/choices or allowlisted public reference only. Costs/progress units and enemy scan disclosure require separate audits; no enemy research arrays.

disabled-relations.predicate: Known contacts and own treaties/visible indicators only; native labels, not hidden exact AI attitudes.

disabled-intelligence.predicate: Own allocation/mission/pool as displayed; no opponent allocations or hidden spy internals.

disabled-history.predicate: Native chart granularity/precision and known player coverage only. displayedValue is formatted chart value, never hidden exact history.

context.predicate: Initialized live registered input owner bound to the local player, top-context interaction only. Copy IDs/labels/enabled flags; omit cheat/debug fields and unaudited formatted text. Parent visibility is not action authority.

disabled-view.predicate: Per-owner rendered title/lines/selection audit required. A process calculating a hidden event is not authorization to publish its text or arguments.

disabled-saves.predicate: Initialized local slot metadata only, both entry routes. No filename/path/save bytes or filesystem listing.

disabled-scores.predicate: Only initialized sorted native Hall of Fame table during its lifetime, both menu/end-game entry routes.

disabled-lobby.predicate: Native advertised sessions/current local lobby/chat; bounded copied text only. Queries do not pump networking or expose NETMOX state.

disabled-combat.predicate: Active observed battle or retained observed result for the bound perspective; field-level scan/target policy and cleanup-before-result capture audit required. No unseen computed battles.

disabled-resource.predicate: Opaque allowlisted reference/current-view resource capability only; no arbitrary LBX entry or OS path. Check decoded and encoded caps before allocation.

disabled-frame.predicate: Atomic copied frame and matching palette captured by their owner at the same generation; service never reads presenter surface concurrently.

disabled-presentation.predicate: Explicit locally granted presentation mode only; reader connection never changes audio/window/timing ownership. Film counts mean frames drawn, not last index.
